prompt: Add the music at {music} under the whole Splice project {project} on an audio lane, ducked under the narration, and normalized for social loudness. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: music item
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and media_kind(i['params']['media']) == 'audio' for i in items)

checks.name: ducked
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and 'duck' in i['params'] for i in items)

checks.name: normalized
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and i['params']['volume'] != 1 for i in items)
